name: clinical_trial_outcomes
description: Reported outcomes from a clinical study report or publication.
instructions: Extract every explicitly reported outcome measurement and every reported comparison between arms. Capture negative and non-significant results too - they are data. One record per arm per outcome per timepoint. Never combine two arms into one record; use comparator for the arm being compared against.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Name of the endpoint as written, e.g. 'overall survival'.

fields.name: outcome_type
fields.description: Role of the endpoint in the study.

fields.name: arm
fields.description: The single study arm or group this record describes.

fields.name: comparator
fields.description: Arm this one is compared against, else null.

fields.name: timepoint
fields.description: Timepoint as written, e.g. 'week 12', else null.

fields.name: n_participants
fields.description: Number of participants contributing to this value.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of the value as written, e.g. 'months', '%'.

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower bound of the reported confidence interval, else null.

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper bound of the reported confidence interval, else null.

fields.name: p_value
fields.description: P-value as written, e.g. '<0.001', else null.

fields.name: significant
fields.description: Statistical significance if the source states it.

fields.name: value_source
fields.description: Where in the document the value was read from.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Qualifying context in the source's own words.

fields.name: source_span
fields.description: REQUIRED verbatim quote (<=200 chars) that contains the number.
